name: ratatoskr-browser-extension
description: Explicit browser capture client for Ratatoskr (Manifest V3).

scripts.package:smoke: node scripts/package-smoke.mjs --release-dir release && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox --no-config-discovery --output json
scripts.release:check: node scripts/release-upload.mjs --store all --dist-dir dist --release-dir release --listing-dir store-assets
scripts.gate: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run package && npm run package:smoke && npm run store-assets && npm run release:check
